family.description: Integral membrane protein family that includes the protein MarC. MarC was thought to be a multiple antibiotic resistance protein. Nevertheless, a study has shown that MarC is not involved in multiple antibiotic resistance [[cite:PUB00077123]]. The function of this family is unclear.
family.name: MarC family integral membrane protein

causal_graphs.family_mapping: ATCC25922 DR76_3329/AIL17056.1 equals UniParc UPI00000DEBB0, 221 aa, PF01914 5-217; N36S relative to K-12 P0AEY1. Table S2 primer mapping predicts CP009072.1 insert 3541797-3542673 including the full CDS and upstream DNA, not independent sequencing of the historical plasmid.
causal_graphs.limitations: Changes are about one twofold dilution and may lie within technical variability; not clinical resistance or direct efflux. pFF6 is not an identical empty vector. ATCC25922 recipient has no ceftriaxone increase and McDermott2008 AG100 tests were negative. Original enrichment interval 3540651-3542008 ends at the MarC start and remains unresolved; no enrichment-fragment edge is asserted.

causal_graphs.limitations: The stronger blot signal is not quantified as a fold-change or significance estimate. Susceptibility negatives are retained separately from RNA effects.

record.description: Integral membrane protein family that includes the protein MarC. MarC was thought to be a multiple antibiotic resistance protein. Nevertheless, a study has shown that MarC is not involved in multiple antibiotic resistance [[cite:PUB00077123]]. The function of this family is unclear.

evidence.explanation: SnatA construct effects and competition are supported, but purified transport, coupling stoichiometry, dimer necessity and native archaeal function remain untested.
MarC selected clones increase uptake/growth; YchE growth rescue does not yield significant uptake in the other tested host.

discussions.notes: Investigate mapped YhgN, YvbG, PH0214/PH0760/PAB0863/PAB2220/MJ0972/MJ1677 independently. Reconstruct variants and B2059 passenger mutations; verify protein abundance and clone sequences. Do not convert AlphaFold or family naming into causal residue evidence. Retain IN_PROGRESS and partial coverage.
discussions.prompt: Extend verified family branches and distinguish cellular phenotypes from a direct transport cycle.
discussions.rationale: Selected SnatA, MarC and YchE experiments do not characterize all 15684 frozen proteins or every PF01914 domain.

evidence.explanation: Table 3 compares with EcNR1 but construction uses MutS-negative EcHW24 or progeny.
TOP10 MIC increases are small and host dependent; primer mapping supports the validation insert but not the reported enrichment boundaries.
AG100 antibiotic-susceptibility negatives and RNA stabilization qualify later resistance interpretations.

discussions.notes: Resolve 2011 MutS background and uncertainty type, 2018 enrichment interval/raw MIC variation, 2025 glucose units and YchE flux, and historical clone sequences. M35stop is not wild-type complementation. Compare matching allele/recipient/vector/assay conditions before reconciliation. Retain negative and unassessed branches in evidence/PF01914; any additional edges require a successor review.
discussions.prompt: Resolve host, allele and source discrepancies before making universal MarC claims.
discussions.rationale: Different strains, controls and endpoints produce different directions; source inconsistencies cannot be silently corrected.
